comment: C-first v11 case for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_STASIS). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of stasis, then selects it with #zap; C's NODIR dispatch reaches this distinct switch arm. C updates svl.level.flags.stasis_until with rn1(21, 10), preventing teleportation during the duration. Include a nearby monster and a short wait only if needed to make the level effect observable. Keep only after a source-reaching C record, independent byte-identical rerecord, and comparison to the earlier wand cases.
